body.statement: Because the declared parameter domains give \(c_X\le1\le C_X\), the uniform context density of \(P^\dagger\) obeys the stated density envelope directly. The explicit law \(P^\dagger\) belongs to \(\mathcal P_{\Delta_0,b_0}^{\mathrm{fg}}\), and \(\mathcal P_{\Delta_0,b_0}^{\mathrm{fg}}\subseteq\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}}\). Hence both the fixed-gap and Hölder--margin classes are nonempty under the stated parameter domains.
body.justification: An explicit common witness prevents the frontier from being driven by mutually inconsistent density, margin, gap, mean-bound, or benchmark-exposure constants.
body.gap: Contextual-bandit rate theorems ordinarily suppress compatibility of fixed class constants; this result records the witness needed when the fixed-gap subclass is itself a theorem domain.
body.consumer: The feasibility supporting lemma and fixed-gap frontier theorem optimize over genuine law classes rather than obtaining vacuous bounds over an empty parameter space.
